copy_coverage.basis: common physical directory covering every requested path of each prefix; no compiler or semantic identity claim

pending_prefixes.registry_existence: unverified except for tarball URLs in checked local package-lock snapshots

scope: offline CP3 acquisition only; an importer pragma describes the importing file, not the missing file
selection: union of target primary and any-candidate CP4.1 CP3 attributions
tier_definition: T1 needs a reachable lock installation and exact release, T2 an applicable dependency spec. Weakest package tier per unit and per project; no pending package is separate.
